_doc: The Gallery (GF.06) is the tutorial room: one exhibit per way of getting an object into the house. src/gen_plaques.py renders one PNG plaque per entry into assets/plaques/<key>.png, writes the plaque boards (furniture GAL_PLAQUE_<KEY>) into the storey JSON and copies title/provenance/license/howto/prompt as the `gallery` block (-> Pset_Gallery) onto the exhibit element. `element` is the exhibit's id in data/ground_floor.json, a variant file or a product; null puts the Pset_Gallery on the plaque itself. `plaque.at` is the centre of the board on the wall face (x, y), `plaque.normal` points into the room; boards are 0.30 x 0.20 m with their centre 1.5 m above the floor.

exhibits.title: Welcome to the Gallery
exhibits.howto: This room is the tutorial. Every exhibit shows one way to get an object into your house. Click anything to read how it was made.
exhibits.prompt: Walk me through the gallery exhibits and what each one teaches

exhibits.title: 1  Boxes in JSON
exhibits.howto: A furniture entry with parts[].boxes: carcass and shelves as absolute metre boxes, one IFC element, two colours. The Dimensions prop is checked against the geometry on every build; data/rules/gallery.json pins the size.
exhibits.prompt: Add a 0.8 x 0.4 x 2.0 m bookshelf with five shelves on the north wall of the study

exhibits.title: 2  Catalogue product, placed with ./place
exhibits.howto: Define the geometry once in data/products/ in its local frame, then ./place add demo-bookshelf CAT_ID --storey GF --at x,y,z --rotation 0. Instances survive variant reloads and room regeneration.
exhibits.prompt: Place a second demo-bookshelf in the living room with ./place

exhibits.title: 3  Procedural mesh (Python)
exhibits.howto: Curved shapes the primitives cannot express are generated as OBJ by a Python function and referenced with {mesh, at, rotation_z, scale}. Regenerate with uv run python src/gen_assets.py.
exhibits.prompt: Generate a 0.5 m tall spiral vase with src/gen_assets.py and put it on the sideboard in the living room

exhibits.title: 4  Imported mesh, Poly Haven (CC0)
exhibits.provenance: Marble Bust 01 by Rico Cilliers, polyhaven.com/a/marble_bust_01
exhibits.howto: Found with uv run python src/find_asset.py "bust", converted with src/convert_asset.py (headless Blender) to metres, Z up, origin centre. The licence travels in the IFC props: MeshSource, MeshLicense, MeshURL, MeshAuthor.
exhibits.prompt: Find a CC0 vase on Poly Haven and place it on the dining table

exhibits.title: 5  Imported mesh, Sketchfab (CC-BY)
exhibits.provenance: This work is based on "Old Soviet teapot" (https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/old-soviet-teapot-9b087673052446299e6decda222a42da) by Amagitsune (https://sketchfab.com/Amagitsune) licensed under CC-BY-4.0 (http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)
exhibits.howto: Same pipeline as the Poly Haven bust, plus the attribution the licence requires: on this plaque, in assets/README.md and in the Attribution prop of the element.
exhibits.prompt: Find a CC-BY teapot on Sketchfab, convert it with src/convert_asset.py and credit the author in the props

exhibits.title: 6  Image on a surface
exhibits.provenance: The Great Wave off Kanagawa, Katsushika Hokusai, c. 1831; Wikimedia Commons, public domain
exhibits.howto: A part with texture {image, u_axis, v_axis} projects a JPEG or PNG under assets/ onto its box; the IFC stores real UV coordinates. The frame is one plain box behind it.
exhibits.prompt: Hang a 60 x 41 cm print of assets/picture_great_wave.jpg above the bed

exhibits.title: 7  Variants
exhibits.provenance: data/variants.json group gallery_centre; data/variants/gallery_centre/bench.json and sculpture.json
exhibits.howto: A group owns the ids GAL_CENTRE_*. uv run python src/variant.py list shows the variants; load gallery_centre sculpture swaps the entries in the storey JSON and rebuilds; save captures hand edits back into the variant file.
exhibits.prompt: Switch the gallery centre to the sculpture variant

exhibits.title: 8  Rules on the built geometry
exhibits.provenance: data/rules/gallery.json, rule gallery-walkway-clear (kind: clear); the terracotta strip is FLOOR_GF_WALKWAY_MARK
exhibits.howto: The strip marks a zone that must stay empty. Rules run on the built IFC after every build. Drag the empty plinth 20 cm south into the strip and ./build.sh fails, naming the element and the overlap.
exhibits.prompt: Add a clear rule that keeps 90 cm in front of the bedroom wardrobe free

exhibits.title: 9  Your turn
exhibits.provenance: An empty plinth, GAL_PLINTH_EMPTY, 0.5 x 0.5 x 0.9 m
exhibits.howto: Pick any technique from this room. The find-asset skill fetches and converts a licensed mesh; the model-change skill measures, edits, builds and renders.
exhibits.prompt: Find a CC0 plant on Poly Haven and put it on the empty plinth in the gallery
